messages:
alex: Heads up — thinking of doing a 'LAN + snacks' chill night next Thu (5pm onward) in the big conference room. Projector + surge strips available. Anyone in?
jamie: count me in! bringing my PS5 and Smash cart :)
riley: I'll bring my mini router + ethernet switch. Need an IP?
game-night-bot: Reminder: Reserve 'conf-large' at 17:00 on 2025-12-15.
sam: RSVP: +1 (partner). Also can bring power strips and extension cords.
marisol: I can bring chips and sodas. Any dietary prefs? Gluten-free crackers ok?
alex: gluten-free's good. Also thinking 3v3 Rocket League bracket? or boardgames?
jamie: Rocket League yes. Also thumbs if anyone wants tournament rules: best of 3s till semis, finals bo5.
riley: Will there be internet? office wifi sometimes drops — I can set up a local DHCP on my router & NAT.
alex: perfect — if you can also bridge for guest vlan that'd be ideal.
sam: Quick question: can we keep it quiet after 9:30? have late interviews.
alex: yep we'll wind down by 9:15.
marisol: I'll label snacks and bring napkins :).
jamie: anyone want to borrow a controller? I have an extra Switch Pro.
alex: @riley can you post the ethernet diagram and port numbers? maybe paste in the thread.
riley: sure — network plan: switch uplink -> office core (port 12), spare patch panel ports 5-8 for devices. bring LAN cables 2-3m.
jamie: also pls no spoilers in chat for the co-op campaign we're doing — @sam and i are mid-arcade run :sweat_smile:
sam: affirmed.
alex: I'll set up a tiny scoreboard Google Sheet and post link on Thu.
game-night-bot: RSVP count updated: 6 humans, 2 controllers, 1 projector, 1 PS5, 1 Switch.
marisol: votes: chips > pretzels > nothing else. :popcorn:
jamie: hype. see y'all next Thu!
alex: Thanks everyone — will ping again with final logistics.
